prompts.title: Dramatic Shadow Sofa Portrait
prompts.text: A dramatic black and white cinematic wide-medium shot of a man sitting on a dark sofa against a plain wall. A sharp diagonal beam of light cuts through the darkness, illuminating him as he sits with his head tilted back and his hand covering his eyes in distress or exhaustion. Wearing a traditional collared shalwar kameez, moody atmosphere, high contrast, deep shadows, dramatic storytelling photography.

prompts.title: Guitar and Rose Riverbank
prompts.text: A stylish South Asian man sitting on a grassy riverbank near still, reflective water. He is wearing a black long-sleeve shirt, black trousers, over-ear headphones around his neck, a wristwatch, and crisp white sneakers. He holds a vibrant red rose in one hand. Beside him on the grass stands a light-brown acoustic guitar and a glass bottle. Bright pink flower petals are scattered around the grass and floating on the water. Clear, mirror-like water reflection of the entire scene. Selective color editing style: grayscale background with vibrant red rose, brown acoustic guitar, and pink petals popping out. Cinematic lighting, shallow depth of field, out-of-focus background, 85mm lens, 8K resolution, photorealistic portrait. Add same face and hair the reference image. Skin: porcelain-smooth, glass skin. Vibrant color grading, vivid filter, realistic iPhone camera photography look, HDR, sharp focus, premium quality.

prompts.title: Black SUV Overhead Portrait
prompts.text: Add same face and hair the reference image. Create an ultra-realistic cinematic overhead top-down portrait with the exact same composition as the reference image: a glossy black Mahindra Scorpio SUV parked on a textured road under natural tree shadows, with the driver-side door open, captured from the same high top-down angle with the full car clearly visible. Keep the same background road, side foliage, reflections on the roof and windshield, and the same car style and perspective. Show a stylish young man sitting casually on the front hood near the windshield, wearing a crisp white shirt, black wide-leg jeans, black sunglasses, a wristwatch, and black-and-white sneakers, holding a takeaway coffee cup in one hand and looking slightly to the side with a calm, confident expression. Keep the pose, framing, monochrome mood, tree-shadow patterns, and overall layout very close to the reference. Professional DSLR photography, ultra-detailed, realistic skin texture, natural anatomy, sharp focus, premium quality.
